label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DP World Tour bans LIV golfers
items.text: DP World Tour CEO Guy Kinnings announced that 2027 membership will be denied to golfers who stay with or sign for LIV Golf, blocking their DP World Tour starts and Ryder Cup eligibility unless they choose a side by mid-November.

items.headline: LPGA begins Asia swing
items.text: The LPGA starts its final six events with a four-tournament swing in Asia, beginning with the Buick LPGA Shanghai from October 15-18.

items.headline: Rahm’s PGA Tour eligibility questioned
items.text: Smylie Kaufman expressed discomfort over Jon Rahm’s eligibility for the PGA Tour Championship Series in 2028 if Rahm has not faced further penalties related to past issues.
